name: Kodokuhime
source:
"I've always been able to see ghosts. It's not as big a deal as you'd think."

Himiko's been a wallflower her whole life- so plain and quiet that even the spirits around her never take an interest. But a chance encounter on her way to school might just be the thing to thrust her into the forefront of her very own story.

[from [url=https://nthcircle.itch.io/kodokuhime]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我一直都能看到鬼魂。这并没有你想象的那么严重。”

卑弥呼一生都是壁花，平淡而安静，连她周围的鬼魂都不感兴趣。但她在上学途中的一次偶遇可能只是把她推到了自己故事的最前沿。

[来自[url=https://nthcircle.itch.io/kodokuhime]itch.io[/url]]
